about: Audit D2/X4 (2026-09-25). Compare lines after removing all whitespace; errorPrefixes ignore letter case. `kept`: the Worker keeps the line in its data (only error lines are dropped there). `displayed`: whether a client may show it as a timeline node or headline. Update summaries (「快递状态已更新」, with or without 「，点击查看」 and the trailing >>) are the provider's placeholder for an update it did not show; they are never displayed and clients show the real nodes instead (user instruction 2026-09-12). The transit-time reminder (「您有包裹运输时效变化，请留意取件安排」, either comma, with or without the trailing >>; `transitTimeReminderPattern`) is a placeholder of the same class (user 2026-09-28, joined this vocabulary on 2026-10-01).

vocabulary.transitTimeReminderPattern: ^您有包裹运输时效变化[，,]请留意取件安排(?:>>)?$
